title: Electrum wallet files
whyItMatters: One file per Electrum wallet, each holding the encrypted seed and keys. A copy plus the password is the funds; without it, the file names still show which wallets existed.
source: Electrum FAQ, where is my wallet file: the data directory is ~/.electrum and wallets live in its wallets folder: https://docs.electrum.org/en/latest/faq.html
notes: Wallet files have no extension and are encrypted with the wallet password; watch-only and multisession wallet folders can also appear. The config and network settings sit in the parent ~/.electrum folder, which this rule does not count.
